# Blue Plane Stay

> Official page of Blue Plane Stay, an airplane-cabin themed entire rental unit (private flat, 46 m2) in Jung-gu, Seoul, near Dongdaemun Design Plaza (DDP) and Myeongdong. Sleeps up to 6: 2 bedrooms, 3 queen beds, 2 bathrooms, kitchen, washer and dryer, self check-in from 16:00, check-out by 11:00. 3-minute flat walk to Dongdaemun History and Culture Park Station (Lines 2, 4, 5), Exit 5; Airport Bus 6001 stop for the airport (Toegye-ro 6-ga, Gwanghui-dong Community Center) 1 minute away, arrival stop (Baiton Hotel) 5 minutes. 3rd floor, no elevator (luggage help on request). Registered hostel business with Jung-gu Office, Seoul.

## Facts at a glance
- Name: Blue Plane Stay (Korean: 블루플레인 스테이)
- Type: entire rental unit, airplane-cabin interior, up to 6 guests
- For families and groups: up to 6 guests together in one flat, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a kitchen and a washer and dryer, the whole flat to yourselves
- Rooms: bedroom 1 with two queen beds, bedroom 2 with one queen bed, 2 bathrooms, kitchen, washer and dryer
- Location: Toegye-ro, Ssangnim-dong, Jung-gu, Seoul (near DDP); full address is shared after booking
- Transit: Dongdaemun History and Culture Park Station Exit 5, 3 minutes on foot; Airport Bus 6001 boarding stop 1 minute, arrival stop 5 minutes
- Gimpo Airport: Line 5 with no transfer to Dongdaemun History and Culture Park Station (Exit 5), then 3 minutes on foot
- Myeongdong: 2 subway stops on Line 4, no transfer
- Check-in from 16:00, check-out by 11:00, self check-in
- Registration: hostel business, Jung-gu Office, Seoul, no. 2026-000060
- Host: Jisoo (co-host Jw)
- Reviews: 5.0 on Airbnb from 12 reviews, Guest favourite, as of 2026-10-09
